label: Model Config
title: Model Config
subtitle: Allows agents to inspect available AI models and set the project's default model at runtime.
whenToUse: Used by orchestrator agents that need to switch models based on task requirements — for example, switching to a cheaper model for a high-volume step and back to a more capable one for final synthesis.

methods.name: List Models
methods.description: Returns all available AI models with metadata (context window, pricing, capabilities).

methods.name: Get Model Info
methods.description: Returns details about a specific model.

mediaCaption: A List Models action returning a table of available models with context window and pricing information
